source.note: Article body is inside the Inertia data-page JSON; only this one official page was used, no linked pages fetched.

quotations: The account level criteria for being eligible for Gumroad Discover is: Your payout settings must be filled in.
Reach a balance of at least $100 USD from enough genuine sales (not self-purchases or asking your partner/housemates to buy your product).
Be verified by our risk team in the risk review process , which can take on average 3 weeks after you pass the $100 threshold.

Once the above criteria are satisfied, a product will be listed on Discover if: Made at least one successful sale (refunded sales don't count) A category has been selected for your product. Ratings are enabled
Note: Products on Discover are automatically opted into the Gumroad Affiliates Program.

fees_from_prior_evidence.direct: 10% + $0.50 per transaction via profile or direct links
fees_from_prior_evidence.discover: 30% per transaction when new customers find and buy through Discover

documented_requirements: USD 100 balance from genuine third-party sales before account eligibility
risk-team review averaging ~3 weeks after crossing USD 100
per product: >=1 non-refunded sale, category selected, ratings enabled
account_specific_unknowns: whether a GlobalLand/founder seller account exists (none verified)
risk review outcome and actual duration
whether CAD-priced items reach USD 100 balance at the same rate (currency conversion)
reasoning: Discover is gated behind at least USD 100 of genuine sales plus ~3-week risk review, and each product needs its own prior sale. Every first buyer, and enough buyers to reach USD 100 (e.g. 5 sales at USD 20, or 3 at USD 49 before fees), must be acquired outside Gumroad through direct links. A Gumroad account alone supplies a payment page and settlement, not discovery. This corrects any implication in platform-managed-settlement-fit.json that option B provides marketplace exposure at launch.
implication_for_SERVICE_PAYMENT_COLLECTI: No material change to the payment blocker: option B remains a collection route only; acquisition must come from our own already-live pages (CSV, welfare, Shopify example) or other direct channels.

next_experiment.reason: Any Gumroad experiment requires a founder-owned seller account (not available). The only accessible first-buyer exposure is the three existing live pages whose observation windows end 2026-11-19/20; no new experiment is added.
next_experiment.reconsideration_trigger: A founder-provided Gumroad profile URL, or a classified REQUEST in commercial_feedback.

limits: One official help page, untrusted content, observed once; Gumroad may change criteria. No account, agreement, contact or credential probe.
